title: The Sex Doctors
author: Dr. Marianne Brandon and Dr. Abe Morgentaler
description: Tune in to the Ultimate Podcast on Sexual Health and Relationships! Join clinical psychologist and certified sex therapist Dr. Marianne Brandon, alongside her husband, renowned urologist and sexual medicine specialist Dr. Abraham Morgentaler, for insightful discussions on intimacy, desire, and well-being. This expert duo dives deep into the science and psychology of sexual health, exploring practical advice on building stronger relationships, enhancing intimacy, and navigating common sexual concerns. Whether you're looking to improve your relationship or gain a better understanding of sexual health, this podcast offers the expertise you need.
